description: GET /search/commits with GitHub commit-search syntax (e.g. "repo:owner/name fix login author:octocat"). Runs as every connected account and merges the envelopes (items verbatim, deduplicated).

per_page.description: Results per page (GitHub's default is 30, max 100).

q.description:
GitHub search query syntax. A query can mix two kinds of terms:
- Qualifiers such as `repo:owner/name`, `is:open`, `label:bug`, `author:octocat`, separated by spaces. Every qualifier must match: `author:octocat repo:owner/name` means items by `octocat` in `owner/name`. Exclude with `-`, e.g. `-label:wontfix`. AND / OR / NOT never apply to qualifiers; for `repo:a/b OR repo:c/d`, run one search per repo.
- Plain text terms, which may be joined with AND / OR / NOT (at most five per query), e.g. `repo:owner/name crash OR panic`.

sort.description: Sort field; best match when omitted.
